requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Concern-mixing detected. Decomposed into one functional requirement (inform security service) and one quality requirement (2s notification SLA) as per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service
structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service upon detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action. The trigger condition is 'detecting damage'.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The notification to the security service shall occur within 2 seconds of detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted the timing constraint as a separate quality requirement. The glossary defines 'within 2 s' as the maximum elapsed time.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not specify the exact mechanism of 'informing' (e.g., API call, message queue) as this was not detailed.
